text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san, happy birthday☆ To get right to 
the point, do you have any requests for 
Falco?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To thank you for always waking me up and 
everything, I'll do my absolute best at 
whatever it is☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Anything, you say? Then please allow 
me one request."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I would like to create a schedule for you 
down to the second. Waking up, transit, 
meals, training... everything.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Byuh...?! T-That's way too hard for Falco, 
or should I say totally impossible...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-But... if it will make Flash-san happy! 
Falco will make sure to sing the Happy 
Birthday song in exactly ten seconds 
flat~!!" || "B-But... if it will make 
Flash-san happy! Falco will make sure to 
sing the happy birthday song in exactly 
ten seconds flat~!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. My apologies, that was a Scherz— 
a joke, in other words. You offered to do 
anything, so I couldn't resist tempting 
fate."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
T-Tempted by the devil...? Flash-san, you 
come up with the weirdest jokes 
sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Still, I really do want to hear a birthday 
song that lasts exactly 10 seconds, so...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? Evil spirits are still hanging 
around~!
